wriggling.definition: Form of wriggle (gerund participle present): To twist one's body to and fro with short, writhing motions; to squirm.

wright.definition: A builder or maker of something.

wringing.definition: Form of wring (gerund participle present): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

wrinkled.definition: Form of wrinkle (participle past): To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrinkles.definition: Form of wrinkle (plural): A small furrow, ridge or crease in an otherwise smooth surface.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

wristlets.definition: Form of wristlet (plural): An elastic band worn to keep a glove from slipping off the wrist.

wrists.definition: Form of wrist (plural): The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

wristwatch.definition: A watch that is worn on a strap or band fastened around the wrist.

wristwatches.definition: Form of wristwatch (plural): A watch that is worn on a strap or band fastened around the wrist.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writes.definition: Form of write (indicative present singular third-person): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writings.definition: Form of writing (plural): Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

wry.definition: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).

y.definition: Form of year (abbreviation): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yahoo.definition: A rough, coarse, loud or uncouth individual.

yale.definition: A mythical beast in European mythology and heraldry, usually portrayed as an antelope- or goatlike four-legged creature with large horns that it can swivel in any direction.

yammered.definition: Form of yammer (participle past): To complain peevishly.

yammering.definition: Form of yammer (gerund participle present): To complain peevishly.

yang.definition: A principle in Chinese and related East Asian philosophies associated with bright, hot, masculine, etc. elements of the natural world.

yank.definition: Form of yank (derogatory often): A sudden, vigorous pull (sometimes defined as mass times jerk, or rate of change of force).

yankee.definition: A native or inhabitant of some part of the United States.

yankees.definition: Form of yankee (plural): A native or inhabitant of some part of the United States.

yankton.definition: A member of a western branch of the Dakota people.

yapping.definition: Form of yap (gerund participle present): Of a small dog, to bark.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yarn.definition: A twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawned.definition: Form of yawn (participle past): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawns.definition: Form of yawn (indicative present singular third-person): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yearned.definition: Form of yearn (participle past): To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

yearners.definition: Form of yearner (plural): someone who yearns.

yearning.definition: Form of yearn (gerund participle present): To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

yearnings.definition: Form of yearning (plural): A wistful or melancholy longing.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yeats.definition: Form of yeat (plural): Form of gate (Northern-Ireland alternative dialectal): A doorlike structure outside a house.

yelling.definition: Form of yell (gerund participle present): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellowhammers.definition: Form of yellowhammer (plural): A passerine bird, Emberiza citrinella, of western Eurasia, which is mainly yellow in colour.

yellowing.definition: Form of yellow (gerund participle present): To become yellow or yellower.

yelped.definition: Form of yelp (participle past): To utter an abrupt, high-pitched noise.

yelping.definition: Form of yelp (gerund participle present): To utter an abrupt, high-pitched noise.

yer.definition: Form of yeah (UK pronunciation-spelling slang): Form of year (colloquial pronunciation-spelling): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yere.definition: Form of year (obsolete): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: Form of yield (gerund participle present): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoked.definition: Form of yoke (participle past): To join (several draught animals) together with a yoke; also, to fasten a yoke (on one or more draught animals) to pull a cart, plough, etc.; or to attach (a cart, plough, etc.) to a draug.

yokel.definition: A person from or living in the countryside, viewed as being unsophisticated or naive.

yokels.definition: Form of yokel (plural): A person from or living in the countryside, viewed as being unsophisticated or naive.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngsters.definition: Form of youngster (plural): A young person.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.

yow.definition: Form of yowe (alternative): A ewe; a female sheep.

yump.definition: To leave the ground briefly when driving over a ridge at high speed.

yup.definition: Form of yuppie (abbreviation clipping informal): A young upwardly mobile urban professional person with an affluent lifestyle.

yvette.definition: A term of derision used by Quebec separatists to refer to Federalist-voting French Quebecois housewives.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zinging.definition: Form of zing (gerund participle present): To move very quickly, especially while making a high-pitched hum.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

zouave.definition: One of a body of soldiers in the French service, originally Kabyle, but now composed of Frenchmen who wear the Kabyle dress.

zouaves.definition: Form of zouave (plural): One of a body of soldiers in the French service, originally Kabyle, but now composed of Frenchmen who wear the Kabyle dress.
